title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer, which is (a).

title: Understanding of Strangeness
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the conservation of strangeness in strong interactions and its violation in weak interactions.

title: Explanation of Decay
description: Important Criteria: The student must clarify that strange particles decay via weak interactions.

title: Creation Process
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss how strange particles can be created from zero strangeness states through strong interactions.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that strange particles cannot exist, as this is incorrect.
